title: Dashboard
overview: This guide covers dashboard workflows for Practice Caregiver.

subtasks.title: Caregiver Dashboard (patient roster & program stats)
subtasks.purpose: The Patient Mgmt side-menu exposes four workflows: Add New Patient, Lookup Patient, Lookup Patient (by RPM date), and Lookup Patient (by CCM date).

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Sign in as a Practice Caregiver — the workspace lands on the practice header (e.g. “Amir Mobile Test Practices”) with the CCM / RPM enrolment counts under the title.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Read the KPI strip: Total Patients, Active Care Plan (provider approved), Complex Care Plan (attested complex CCM), Items Pending Review (care plan changes awaiting provider), and CPT Billing (99490 / 99491 / 99439 counters).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Use the Search patients by name… box or the All Status filter to narrow the list; click CCM or RPM to switch program context, or + Add Patient to launch the enrolment wizard.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: For any row, click the eye icon to open the patient chart, or the pencil icon to edit that patient — the row also surfaces DOB, chronic conditions, last activity, service time, and billing state (e.g. Pending).
